"""Post-hoc scalar training-support trajectory;no activation reconstruction."""
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
from train_directional_bank_trial import read,ref,save,guard
repo=Path('/home/dllu/proj/demosaic');root=repo/'.cache/quality-20261107/V166-common-support-routing-v2'
plan=read(root/'plan-v1.json');guard(plan);training=read(root/'train-result-v1.json');cache=read(plan['cache']['path'])
assert len(training['trace'])==len(cache['batches'])==1000
groups=[];trajectories=[];threshold=1e-4
for arm in training['counts']:
 records=[]
 for row,item in zip(training['trace'],cache['batches'],strict=True):
  c=row['arms'][arm];assert row['step']==item['step'] and row['batch']==item['arrays']
  assert 0<=c['support_mean']<=1 and np.isfinite(c['spectral_delta_RMS']) and c['spectral_delta_RMS']>=0
  records.append({'step':row['step'],'domain':row['domain'],'ADC_only':item['metadata']['noise']['shot']==item['metadata']['noise']['read']==0,
   'support_mean':c['support_mean'],'pre_support_coefficient_RMS':c['spectral_delta_RMS'],
   'direct_RGB_correction_RMS_DN16':c['spatial_correction_RMS_DN16'],'common_support_detached':c['common_support_detached']})
 def summarize(selected):
  values=np.array([v['support_mean'] for v in selected]);assert len(values)
  return {'batches':len(values),'support_mean_min_median_p90_max':np.quantile(values,[0,.5,.9,1]).tolist(),
   'batch_means_below_1e4':int((values<threshold).sum()),'mean_pre_support_coefficient_RMS':float(np.mean([v['pre_support_coefficient_RMS'] for v in selected])),
   'mean_direct_RGB_correction_RMS_DN16':float(np.mean([v['direct_RGB_correction_RMS_DN16'] for v in selected]))}
 for domain in ['mesh','photo','weak','flat','mixed']:
  for adc in [False,True]:
   selected=[v for v in records if v['domain']==domain and v['ADC_only']==adc]
   if selected:groups.append({'arm':arm,'domain':domain,'ADC_only':adc,**summarize(selected)})
 bins=[]
 for low,high in [(1,100),(101,250),(251,500),(501,750),(751,1000)]:
  bins.append({'steps_inclusive':[low,high],**summarize([v for v in records if low<=v['step']<=high])})
 above=[v['step'] for v in records if v['support_mean']>=threshold]
 trajectories.append({'arm':arm,'last_step_batch_support_mean_at_least_1e4':max(above,default=0),
  'common_fixed_support_batches':sum(v['common_support_detached'] for v in records),'bins':bins,'records':records})
output=repo/'docs/results/v166-training-support-trajectory-v1.json';assert not output.exists()
save(output,{'status':'completed-posthoc-original-training-scalar-reduction','training':ref(root/'train-result-v1.json'),'cache':plan['cache'],
 'threshold':threshold,'groups':groups,'trajectories':trajectories,'source':dict(ref(Path(__file__)),text=Path(__file__).read_text()),
 'new_forwards':0,'new_noise_draws':0,'scope':'Post-hoc after observing low support on training snapshots. Original scalar batch means from pre-update forwards,not post-update checkpoint activations or independently reconstructed gate maps. B4 batches share sizes within batch,but a mean/quantile across batches does not pixel-weight different sizes. Threshold inherited from V165 archived-support review;not an inference rule. Descriptive adaptive training data,not held-out quality or isolated proof of why support closes. Numerical inference/losses and V166 fixed review unchanged.'})
for row in trajectories:print(row['arm'],row['last_step_batch_support_mean_at_least_1e4'],row['common_fixed_support_batches'],row['bins'][-1])
